title: Surreal Tarot Ritual
description: A surreal desert scene features a large ornate golden oval frame dripping with blood on the left, containing a blue-haired woman kissing a skeleton wearing a golden headdress. In the center, a robed figure holds a tarot card while standing beside potted flowers. A massive rainbow serpent coils across the dunes toward a stone tower on the right, where a red bird carries an ace of hearts card. A large smiling moon with yellow eyes and aurora borealis dominate the starry night sky, with orange and red laser-like beams connecting elements.
